Population increased in Gosport

The estimated population of Gosport in 2024 was 82,921 usual residents, a rise of 0.2% since 2023.

This meant that Gosport's rate of population change placed it among the slowest growing 20 percent of local authority districts in England and Wales.

In the period from mid-2021 to mid-2024, the population estimate of Gosport increased by 0.9%.

Over this slightly longer period, Gosport was also among the 20% slowest growing local authority districts in England and Wales.

Age profile of Gosport

The average (median) age rose to 43.9 years between 2023 and 2024.

You can see how the age profile of Gosport has changed since 2011 in the population pyramid below.

sections.content:
Gosport is an area that is classed as urban in nature according to the 2021 Census Rural Urban Classification.

By age category, Gosport's population of 82,921 usual residents was made up of:

  • 14,401 people aged 0 to 15 years, (17.4%)
  • 49,923 people aged 16 to 64 years, (60.2%)
  • 18,597 people aged 65 years and over, (22.4%)

    • Compared with England and Wales as a whole, Gosport has a slightly higher proportion of people aged 65 years and over (22.4% compared with 18.9% for England and Wales).

Contributors to population change

We look at different flows of people into and out of areas and births and deaths to see what is driving population change in each area.

In Gosport, the largest contribution to population change in the year to mid-2024 was from net international migration.

sections.title: Contributors to population change in Gosport
sections.subtitle: How the population changed, by component

sections.content:
We estimate that, for Gosport, between 2023 and 2024:

  • More deaths than births led to a fall in the population of 221 people (-0.3%). In total, there were 748 births and 969 deaths in Gosport.
  • Net internal migration (people moving to and from other areas in the UK) led to a fall in the population of 3 (0%). There were 3,827 people entering the area and 3,830 people leaving the area.
  • Net international migration led to an increase in Gosport's population of 311 (0.4%) as a result of 442 people entering the area and 131 people leaving the area.
  • Other change (which includes changes to armed forces personnel and prisoners) for Gosport was less than 0.1%.

Revisions to 2023 population estimates

We regularly revise our initial population estimates as we get more data and methods improve.

Our revised estimate for the population of Gosport in mid-2023 is 82,742.

Within this, international migration was revised upwards by 178 people and internal migration estimates were revised upwards by 179 people.

Overall, there was an revision upwards of 357 people.
